Job Title;	Vehicle Painter
Salary Range;	$79,500 - $87,000 | depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closes Date;	30 Days  

About the Client
Our client is a premier name in the automotive repair industry, renowned for a commitment to excellence that spans over three decades. Operating from a state-of-the-art, state-approved facility, they specialize in restoring vehicles to their pristine, pre-accident condition, with a particular expertise in comprehensive collision repair and high-quality refinishing. They are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Vehicle Painter to join their dedicated team and uphold their reputation for flawless finishes. 

About the Role: 
This role is central to the final and most visible stage of the restoration process. As a Vehicle Painter, you will be entrusted with transforming prepared vehicle bodies with a flawless, factory-quality finish. You will be responsible for colour matching, application, and finishing, ensuring the final product not only meets but exceeds customer expectations. This position requires an artist's eye for detail and a technician's understanding of modern refinishing systems.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

Surface Preparation & Masking
• Identify and remove rough spots, imperfections, and old paint from vehicle panels using hand tools and power sanders.
• Mask off areas not requiring paint with precision tape and paper to ensure clean, sharp lines and protect surrounding components.

Paint Matching & Mixing
• Colour match and blend paints to achieve exact shade matches, including metallic and pearl finishes, and select pre-mixed paints as required.
• Adjust tint formulas and test spray-outs to guarantee seamless integration with existing vehicle paintwork.

Application & Finishing
• Apply primer, basecoat, and clearcoat using spray-guns, carefully sanding between coats for a smooth, defect-free surface.
• Perform touch-up repairs, then polish and wax completed paintwork to restore gloss and depth.

Final Detailing & Protection
• Remove masking materials, then wax and polish finished panels to a high lustre.
•Treat vehicles with rust-proofing chemicals and apply protective coatings as needed.

Specialist Work
• Paint custom signs, graphics, and artwork directly onto vehicles when required.

Requirements
• Trade qualification in Automotive Refinishing or Vehicle Painting, or at least 2 years of full-time relevant experience.
• Proven ability to colour match, mix paints, and apply primer, basecoat, and clearcoat using spray-guns in a collision repair environment.
• Strong knowledge of surface preparation, sanding techniques, and masking procedures to achieve defect-free finishes.
• Experience with rust-proofing treatments, polishing, waxing, and final detailing.
• Familiarity with painting signs, graphics, and artwork on vehicles is highly regarded.
• Commitment to workplace health and safety, including proper use of PPE and spray booth protocols.

If you are a skilled Vehicle Painter who takes pride in producing exceptional work and wants to contribute to a business with an outstanding reputation, we encourage you to apply.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

About This Role:
We are seeking a passionate and nurturing Child Care Worker for an exclusive partnership with a prestigious, community-focused preschool. This role is ideal for an educator who believes in the power of a holistic, play-based approach and values creating a warm, homelike environment for children. The centre prides itself on its beautiful, natural settings and its philosophy that emphasises emotional security, creativity, and foundational learning through exploration. We are looking for a dedicated professional who can contribute to this nurturing atmosphere, design a stimulating program inspired by the Early Years Learning Framework, and build strong, collaborative relationships with families and the wider community. This is a unique opportunity to join a team deeply committed to providing an exceptional early learning experience.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
Program Delivery & Child Development:
• Design and implement stimulating educational programs aligned with the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF)
• Facilitate intentional teaching moments through play-based activities including storytelling, music, art and sensory exploration
• Observe and document children's progress to support individual learning goals and share insights with families
• Guide social-emotional development by modelling positive behaviour and conflict resolution strategies

Daily Care & Wellbeing:
• Maintain impeccable hygiene standards including nappy changing, toileting assistance and mealtime supervision
• Create predictable routines that provide children with emotional security while allowing flexibility for spontaneous learning
• Conduct thorough safety checks of indoor/outdoor environments and resources before activities
• Administer first aid when required and follow health management plans for children with additional needs

Family & Community Engagement:
• Build trusting relationships with families through daily conversations and formal progress updates
• Collaborate with room leaders to create displays that make children's learning visible to parents
• Participate in community events and centre initiatives that strengthen family connections

Compliance & Professionalism:
• Maintain current working with children check - first aid certification and relevant qualifications
• Contribute to quality improvement processes through reflective practice
• Attend staff meetings and professional development sessions to enhance practice

Skills & Requirements:
• Certificate III or Diploma in Early Childhood Education & Care (or ACECQA-approved equivalent)
• Proven 1-year minimum experience in long day care or similar setting.
• Demonstrated knowledge of EYLF and National Quality Standards
• Genuine passion for early childhood development with endless patience and creativity
• Current First Aid, Asthma & Anaphylaxis certificates as well as proof of vaccination
• Working with children rights
• Police check
• Strong communication skills to engage with children, colleagues and families
• References from previous employers

Why Apply?
This is more than a job - it's an opportunity to shape young lives in an environment that values educator wellbeing as much as child development. You'll receive:

• Above-award wages for qualified candidates
• Paid professional development opportunities
• Supportive leadership team with realistic expectations
• Purpose-built facilities with quality resources

If you're ready to make your mark in early childhood education with an organisation that values your expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

How to Apply:
Submit your resume and cover letter addressing your experience with the EYLF and your approach to play-based learning. Successful applicants will require valid working rights and must pass background checks.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

result.description:
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Systems Test Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our technology systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies, identifying defects, and working collaboratively with development and infrastructure teams to deliver robust, high-quality solutions. This role suits a methodical and analytical professional with a strong technical background in software and systems testing, a commitment to quality assurance best practices, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment.
## Key Responsibilities
- Specify, develop, and execute detailed test plans, test scripts, and test cases to validate the behaviour, functionality, and integrity of ICT systems across multiple platforms and environments.
- Identify, diagnose, and document functionality errors and faults in systems and programming code within established testing protocols, quality standards, and compliance guidelines to ensure systems perform to specification.
- Design and conduct regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure new and updated systems meet defined requirements and business needs.
- Utilise automated test software and frameworks to streamline testing processes, improve test coverage, and increase efficiency across the software development lifecycle.
- Produce clear and comprehensive defect reports, test summary reports, and related quality assurance documentation, ensuring traceability from requirements through to test outcomes.
- Perform systems architecture reviews and assessments, evaluating current and future hardware and software configurations, and contributing recommendations to inform strategic technical direction.
- Collaborate closely with software developers, business analysts, and project managers to clarify requirements, resolve defects, and support timely delivery of system releases.
- Create, review, and maintain technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, instructional materials, technical specifications, and maintenance inventory records.
- Analyse test results and defect trends to identify recurring issues, recommend process improvements, and support continuous quality improvement initiatives across the organisation.
- Participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, contributing a quality assurance perspective throughout the development cycle.
- Assess risks associated with system changes and releases, providing input into risk mitigation strategies and supporting informed decision-making across project and operational teams.
- Support the evaluation, selection, and implementation of testing tools, methodologies, and frameworks to ensure the organisation's testing capabilities remain current and effective.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
- Demonstrated experience in ICT systems testing, quality assurance, or a closely related technical role, with a solid understanding of the software development and systems engineering lifecycle.
- Proficiency in writing and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts across functional, non-functional, and regression testing scenarios.
- Hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, TestNG, or comparable technologies.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex system faults and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience producing high-quality technical documentation, including test reports, defect logs, operational guides, and system specifications.
- Familiarity with agile and DevOps methodologies and the ability to integrate quality assurance activities into iterative development workflows.
- Solid understanding of systems architecture, network infrastructure, and software integration concepts relevant to enterprise ICT environments.
- Competency with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Zephyr, or similar platforms.
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and organisational skills, with a strong commitment to delivering quality outcomes within agreed timeframes.
## Preferred Qualifications
- ISTQB certification (Foundation Level or above) or an equivalent recognised qualification in software testing or quality assurance.
- Experience working in regulated industries or environments with strict compliance, security, or governance requirements, such as government, finance, or healthcare.
- Exposure to performance and load testing tools such as Apache JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling.
- Familiarity with cybersecurity testing principles, including vulnerability assessments and secure coding practices.
- Experience with cloud-based environments and platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, and an understanding of how they impact testing strategies.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and associated tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Bamboo.
- A postgraduate qualification or additional certifications in project management, IT governance, or related fields, such as ITIL or PRINCE2, would be highly regarded.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and forward-thinking team that values technical excellence and continuous improvement, where your contributions directly shape the quality of systems used across the organisation.
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and attendance at relevant conferences and events.
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with options for hybrid work arrangements, supporting a healthy work-life balance without compromising on career growth.
- Work on complex, large-scale ICT projects that offer genuine variety and the opportunity to deepen your expertise across diverse technologies and industries.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with a clear pathway for career progression within a growing organisation that invests in its people.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
